Definition: adverb from G4152; non-physically, i.e. divinely, figuratively:--spiritually.
BiblicalUsage: Pneumatikos as an adverb means spiritually, in a spiritual way. The natural man does not receive the things of the Spirit, for they are spiritually discerned, says 1 Corinthians 2:14, and the great city is called spiritually Sodom and Egypt in Revelation 11:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe some things can only be seen by the Spirit, and the natural eye will always miss them.
